papers.title: Invisible Ink Threats: Adversarial Goals Behind Legitimate Tasks in Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Jia-Chen Zhang, Ze-Yu Zhang, Kai-Wei Zhang
papers.affiliations: East China Normal University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文揭示并系统研究了计算机使用代理在面对“隐形墨水威胁”——即伪装成合法任务的低危害间接提示注入攻击——时的严重脆弱性，并提出了攻击基准II-Bench和测试框架HITLCUA来评估和揭示这一风险。

papers.title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory
papers.authors: Kang Liu, Zijing Wang, Yongkang Liu, Mengjie Zhao, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Yifei Zhang, Daling Wang
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University, China
papers.intro: TRAM是一种无需训练的解码增强方法，通过从模型自身推理轨迹中提取并在线更新紧凑的“双时标递归记忆”，再将其注入到选定解码层，从而在长轨迹推理中保留并复用早期推理信息，提升多模态推理准确率。

papers.title: CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yu Chen, Xiaohong Li, Xiaole Wang, Jianjin Zhang, Jun Sun, Yafeng Deng
papers.affiliations: Evermind（盛大集团），Shanda Group（盛大集团），Peking University（北京大学）
papers.intro: CRAFT 提出了一种递归“先选择后融合”的视频 token 压缩方法，通过免训练的全局相似度选择与可学习的门控融合相结合，在约 8 倍压缩时保留骨干模型约 97% 的平均准确率，并显著降低 prefill 时延和计算量。

papers.title: UniHEAR: Unified Heterogeneous-Source Attentive Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Ganzhong Luo, Yang Ren, Hanyong Wang, Shuyu Zheng, Menglong Yang
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, image retrieval, CLIP
papers.affiliations: School of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Sichuan University（四川大学航空航天学院）
papers.intro: UniHEAR 提出一个统一轻量级异构源实体检索与重排框架，通过粗检索描述符显式桥接粗检索与细粒度重排，并利用检索引导的注意力模态门控与熵加权源融合，在E-VQA和InfoSeek上取得SOTA检索与VQA性能。

papers.title: VespaSeg: A Resource-Aware Ground-then-Segment Pipeline for Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.authors: Savindu Dilshan Wickramasinghe
papers.tags: visual grounding, instance segmentation, Segment Anything, object detection
papers.affiliations: Department of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering, University of Moratuwa, Moratuwa, Sri Lanka
papers.intro: VespaSeg 提出了一种“先定位（grounding）后分割（segment）”的模块化指代表达分割流程，利用紧凑视觉语言模型（Florence-2 或 Moondream2）生成目标框，再用 MobileSAM 完成掩码预测，并通过 LoRA 适配和图像嵌入缓存实现精度与资源消耗的良好平衡。

papers.title: PHA-Net: Prototype-based Hierarchical Alignment Network for Text-Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Xiaolun Jing, Kezhao Yin, Xinxing Yang, Genke Yang, Jian Chu
papers.affiliations: Ningbo Artificial Intelligence Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; School of Automation and Intelligent Sensing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Department of Biomedical Engineering, Oregon Health & Science University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于原型（Prototype）的层级对齐网络PHA-Net，通过模态共享原型作为桥梁，结合原型支持的Token合并与原型对比损失，实现文本和视频在个体、局部、全局三个层级的联合高效对齐，从而显著提升文本-视频检索性能。

papers.title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Chengbo Liu, Lifang Zhou, Ruijie Yan, Pei Tan, Ao Sun, Haojun Huang, Guichun Hua, Sining Wei, Yining Chen, Yingying He, Yutao Xie
papers.affiliations: Microsoft（中国北京）；东南大学（中国南京）
papers.intro: RMSWeb 提出一套面向 Web Agent 强化学习的三部分配方——反射条件数据采集、失败模式挖掘和 Salvage-DS 离线 RL 算法，在 Qwen3-VL 8B/32B 上以更少动作步数显著超越 SFT 策略，并在 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web、WebTailBe…

papers.title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
papers.authors: Meibo Hu, Guohao Sun, Annemarie D. Ross, Sheng Li, Zhiqiang Tao
papers.affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology, University of Virginia, National Technical Institute for the Deaf / Rochester Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 提出AttnSign，一种通过空间注意力监督和基于强化学习的运动节律引导，将通用VLM适配为端到端手语翻译器的训练框架，显著提升翻译质量和注意力可解释性。

papers.title: HierDoc: Hierarchical Page-to-Region Evidence Routing for Long-Document Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Rongjian Gu, Wengang Zhou, Junyu Xiong, Yonghui Wang, Bing Yin, Bei Wang, Houqiang Li
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China（中国科学技术大学）、iFLYTEK Research（科大讯飞研究院）、Anhui Transport Consulting & Design Institute Co. Ltd.（安徽省交通规划设计研究总院股份有限公司）
papers.intro: HierDoc提出一个层级证据路由框架，将长文档VQA的证据获取建模为"页面→区域"两阶段集合预测，用阶段式GRPO分别优化两级策略，再让答案模型联合消费选中的整页、区域裁剪和OCR/表格文本，以同时保留全局上下文和细粒度证据。

papers.title: OASIS: Occlusion-aware Single-image Hand Avatar Reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zhisheng Han, Shiyao Wu, Jiayan Qiu, Yakun Ju, Lu Liu, Le Zhang, Pengfei Feng, Huiyu Zhou, Zheheng Jiang
papers.affiliations: University of Leicester, UK; University of Exeter, UK; University of Birmingham, UK; China University of Geoscience, Wuhan, China
papers.intro: 本文提出OASIS，一种基于3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）的单图手部化身重建框架，通过几何对齐视觉证据编码、可见性条件注意力以及Feature-on-Mesh表示，实现高效、高保真且可动画化的单视角手部重建。

papers.title: FlexComposer: Unified Video Compositing from Images to Dynamic Footage with Flexible Trajectory Control
papers.authors: Songchun Zhang, Sitong Guo, Xianghao Kong, Pengwei Liu, Yuwei Guo, Lvmin Zhang, Anyi Rao
papers.affiliations: HKUST, ZJU, CUHK, Stanford University
papers.intro: FlexComposer提出一个统一的轨迹引导条件生成框架，通过规范前景表示、参数无关的时空潜在注入和混合数据课程学习，将静态图像与动态视频资产无缝合成到背景视频中，实现高保真运动控制与光影协调。

papers.title: RayViT: Ray-Conditioned Visual Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Imitation Learning
papers.authors: Qian Wang, Longrui Chen, Peiran Sun, Aleksandar Taranovic, Niklas Freymuth, Ge Li, Weiran Liao, C. F. Maximilian Nagy, Yucheng Tan, Tao Chen, Gerhard Neumann
papers.affiliations: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Germany; University of Leeds, United Kingdom
papers.intro: RayViT通过将Plücker射线图以门控交叉注意力产生的几何感知class token和补丁级几何位置嵌入的方式注入预训练ViT，并辅以跨视图余弦一致性损失，显著提升模仿学习策略在相机扰动下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Human-Centered Validation of the Explainability-Performance Coefficient
papers.authors: Christian Oliva, Luis F. Lago-Fernández
papers.affiliations: Grupo de Neurocomputación Biológica, Departamento de Ingeniería Informática, Escuela Politécnica Superior, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Spain
papers.intro: 论文提出并验证了一个模型无关的可解释性评估指标——EPC score，该指标显式衡量特征选择稀疏性与模型性能之间的权衡，并在表格、文本和图像等多样模态下证明其与人类基于语言情感和空间视觉标注的解释高度一致。

papers.title: FriendBench: Benchmarking Dyadic Familiarity Inference in Humans and Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Jeffrey M. Girard, Jason Z. Zheng, Jacqueline R. Vertino, Antony D'Avirro, Benjamin Peloquin
papers.affiliations: Fluid Concepts Research
papers.intro: FriendBench是首个在控制对话主题条件下，系统比较人类与26个多模态大语言模型从文本、音频、视频三种模态推断双人熟悉度的基准，发现最佳模型与人类群体总体准确率无统计学差异，但模型通过强烈偏向“陌生人”答案来达到同等准确率，而人类则保持类别平衡。

papers.title: DynoDINO: Harnessing Dynamic Latent Information from DINO Features for Multi-Phase Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Yu-Pu Hsu, Jen-Jee Chen, Yu-Chee Tseng
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: College of Artificial Intelligence, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan
papers.intro: DynoDINO是一个统一的端到端多相位医学图像分割框架，通过FFT加速的ZNCC切片对齐、Mix-attention跨相位融合和自适应门控差分残差学习，有效利用DINO预训练特征中的动态潜在信息，在标准、错位及相位缺失条件下显著改善了边界描绘和结构保真度。

papers.title: MoRoute: Dynamic Routing for In-Context Multimodal Video Generation
papers.authors: Chong Gao, Jie Ma, Zhan Peng, Chongxiao Wang, Haoxue Wu, Jun Liang, Guanbin Li, Jing Li
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University; Orange Team, Moku Lab, HUJING Digital Media & Entertainment Group; Huazhong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: MoRoute提出一种统一的多模态视频生成框架，将冻结的VLM和预训练视频DiT视为异构专家，通过块级动态层路由自适应连接二者，并结合上下文条件拼接来统一支持文本、图像和视频驱动的生成与编辑任务，在多个基准上超越现有最佳方法。

papers.title: The K-Space Signature: Frequency-Domain Representation Learning for Medical Deepfake Detection
papers.authors: Riccardo Raciti, Francesco Guarnera, Francesco Rundo, Luca Guarnera, Sebastiano Battiato
papers.affiliations: University of Catania
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于频域（K-Space）残差表示——KSS（K-Space Signature），结合3D MLP-Mixer与ArcFace度量学习头的医学深度伪造检测框架，通过在Log-PSD空间减去全局解剖先验来分离硬件与生成痕迹，实现对多中心、多生成器、跨扫描仪的MRI真实性与合成性高精度判…

papers.title: MoPET: Parameter-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts for Unified Medical Image Classification
papers.authors: Sebastian Doerrich, Daniel Würtinger, Francesco Di Salvo, Shyam Nandan Rai, Christian Ledig
papers.tags: image classification, medical image, multimodal learning, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: xAILab Bamberg, University of Bamberg, Bamberg, Germany
papers.intro: MoPET提出一种基于混合专家（MoE）的参数高效微调框架，通过可学习的稀疏路由器将输入动态分配给一组低秩专家（LoRA和BOFT），在冻结的预训练骨干网络内实现多个异构医学图像数据集的高效统一分类，并利用辅助数据集提升目标域的准确率。

papers.title: CUADebug: Diagnosing and Repairing Computer-Use Agent Failures
papers.authors: Weijia Zhang, Kunlun Zhu, Zeyi Liu, Yinting Chen, Tianyi Ma, Jiateng Liu, Jiaxun Zhang, Bingxuan Li, Xiangru Tang, Heng Ji, Jiaxuan You
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Yale University
papers.intro: 论文提出CUADebug框架，通过CUA特定的错误分类法、人工标注的失败基准CUAErrorBench和工具增强调试器CUADebugger，对计算机使用智能体的失败轨迹进行多模态根因诊断，并将诊断结果用于指导重新执行，从而把事后解释转化为可测试的修复信号。

papers.title: MAGA: Multi-Platform Self-Fusion of GUI Agents via Structured Action Distillation
papers.authors: Hang Yan, Zhangxuan GU, Beitong Zhou, Jiaxuan Chen, Runze Li, Yusong Hu, Shuheng Shen, Changhua Meng
papers.affiliations: 西安交通大学；蚂蚁集团；上海交通大学（具体对应关系见第十二节）
papers.intro: MAGA提出一种基于结构化动作的蒸馏方法，通过学生端细粒度的训练信号重分配与教师端训练专用提示，将多个领域专用的GUI Agent高效融合为单一跨平台模型，显著提升统一模型在各GUI基准上的成功率。
